t:
Identify the true statement.

I. Inward treaty agreement from the foreign ceding companies will require to be stamped in India.
II. Though the agreements are normally received in duplicate, only the copy to be retained by the Indian reinsurer is got stamped.
III. In regard to outward treaties, the copy to be retained in India is got stamped with special adhesive stamp for the required amount, as applicable.
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Free trade and globalising trade in services is an important objective of this world body:-
e: Correct answer: WTO (from the IC85 question bank).

t: _____________ form of reinsurance responds if an accumulation of losses exceeds the deductible selected.
e: Correct answer: Stop loss (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
The accounts for accident proportional reinsurance business are normally rendered on:-

I. Accounts year basis
II. Underwriting year basis
III. Monthly basis
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Credit rating opinion takes into account:-

I. Insurer's ability to pay under his insurance policies and contracts in accordance with their terms
II. Surrender or cancellation penalties
III. Timeliness of payment
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
With regard to Premium on XL cover, 'rate on line': -

I. Assists the reinsurer to judge rating consistency as between various covers that he quotes
II. Provides indication of the number of years in which the limit can be recouped on the basis of the Rate on Line if the total of limit is paid as claim
III. Is higher for each successive higher layer of excess cover
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In reinsurance business, captive companies are often established in:-

I. London
II. United states
III. Tax haven countries
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ________________ clause intends that reinsurance will apply simultaneously and automatically with that of the ceding insurer as soon as his retention is exceeded with reference to surplus reinsurance.
o: Business Covered: Attachment of cessions  proportional
Net retained lines: Protecting net retention
e: Correct answer: Business Covered: Attachment of cessions  proportional (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is a type of reinsurance contract?

I. Facilitative reinsurance
II. Entreaty reinsurance
III. Facultative reinsurance
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: As per ____________________clause, losses will normally be debited to the reinsurer in the accounts.
o: Loss advices and accounting of losses clause
e: Correct answer: Loss advices and accounting of losses clause (from the IC85 question bank).

t: What is the consideration for reinsurance contract?
e: Correct answer: Premium (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement.

I. As per Indian Stamps Act 1899, it is obligatory to stamp a document executed in India.
II. The treaty reinsurance agreement executed in India does not required to be stamped.
III. The Stamp Act provides that every instrument chargeable with duty executed out of India may be stamped within six months after it is received in India
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to rate determination for premium for XL cover.

I. The reinsurer may quote a Flat Rate as a percentage which is applied to the gross premium income of the particular class of business.
II. The flat rate on 'catastrophe' covers is a reflection of the underwriter's experience in that class of business and what the market is prepared to pay.
III. When the rate is applied to the limit of cover it is known as "Rate on Line".
e: Correct answer: I,II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

e: Correct answer: All losses occurring within the contract period are covered, no matter when the original policy was issued (from the IC85 question bank).

t: _______________ is an incentive for ceding insurers to produce profitable business.
e: Correct answer: Profit commission (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In a reinsurance contract, the original insurer who, having issued a policy to an insured to cover a certain risk, desires to relieve himself of a part thereof, is referred as:-
e: Correct answer: Ceding insurer (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Risk retention group:-

I. Originated in the US with the passing of Liability Risk Retention Act, 1981
II. Is a corporation owned and operated by insurance companies, that band together as self-insurers and forms an organization that is chartered and licensed as an insurer in at least one state of US to handle liability insurance
III. Addresses gaps in liability cover for its members such as for medical malpractice in US
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
With regard to property reinsurance, the rating of the first layer of the catastrophe cover depends upon:-

I. The underwriting data
II. Past record of large losses
III. Risk exposure
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
What are the examples of long tail business?

I. Property business
II. Liability business
III. Aviation hull
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which type of Excess of loss reinsurance can be effective for reinsurance of legal  liabilities to third parties?
e: Correct answer: Working Excess of loss (from the IC85 question bank).

t: The basic statistics relating to a treaty are collated from:-
o: Account statements as sent and received
e: Correct answer: Account statements as sent and received (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ___________ is often used as a major means to increase solvency margin like capital and subordinated loan in Europe and the United States.
e: Correct answer: Financial reinsurance (from the IC85 question bank).

Ascertaining cash flow produced by business

Identify the key areas that a Credit Rating Agency looks at.

I. Underwriting
II. International operations of the foreign partners
III. The leverage
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following have been popular with direct insurers principally to help comply with solvency margins and to be able to write business after a major loss event?
e: Correct answer: Contingent capital solution (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement.

I. As soon as a reinsurance acceptance is made, a concurrent decision will have to be taken regarding its retention and underwriting.
II. Retrocession may be resorted to by a lead underwriter who leads quotes on a reinsurance proposal.
III. Retrocession is required to enable acceptance of economical lines.
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to Original conditions clause.

I. Reinsurances are fully subject to the same terms and conditions as the original insurance
II. Premium is to be paid to the reinsurer at the same rate as received by the ceding insurer
III. The insurer and the reinsurer share the same interest
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

Relation between largest risk and catastrophe expo
Decision making on what type of reinsurance arrang
Ascertaining cash flow produced by business
e: Correct answer: This will influence retentions, cover limits and reinsurance costs (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In reinsurance programme design, what is the relevance of Risk based capital?
o: This will influence retentions, cover limits and r
Relation between largest risk and catastrophe exposures accepted by insurer on a gross and net basis to judge financial effects on insurer's capital base
Decision making on what type of reinsurance arrang
Ascertaining cash flow produced by business
e: Correct answer: Relation between largest risk and catastrophe exposures accepted by insurer on a gross and net basis to judge financial effects on insurer's capital base (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
As of 2010, GIC Re is entrusted to manage and administer:-

I. Indian Motor Third Party Declined Pool
II. Indian Terrorism Insurance Pool
III. Indian Property Insurance Pool

t: An insurer or reinsurer may have his own basic treaties to serve as a medium of reciprocity for the inward business in which case he may go in for:-
e: Correct answer: Reciprocal trading (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
The merit of this system is its simplicity, each contract year is self-contained:-

I. Losses occurring basis
II. Risk attaching basis
III. Premium basis
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

e: Correct answer: 1956 (from the IC85 question bank).

e: Correct answer: Self insurance (from the IC85 question bank).

e: Correct answer: Premium for XL cover (from the IC85 question bank).

e: Correct answer: Stop loss (from the IC85 question bank).

e: Correct answer: This form of reinsurance is mainly used in protecting  property risks loss exposures (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement.

I. The anticipated incurred loss ratio to the gross and net accounts in a class are very good indices for measuring the effect of the programme on retentions.
II. The net retained account is expected to sustain its loss ratio over a period of time.
III. The gross direct account is expected to be subject to as wide a variation as the exposures permit.
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In which of the following methods, all losses occurring within the contract period are covered, no matter when the original policy was issued?

I. Losses occurring basis
II. Risk attaching basis
III. Premium basis
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t: National Association of Insurance Commissioners in USA is:-
e: Correct answer: An insurance regulatory body (from the IC85 question bank).

t: The Stamp Act 1899 provides that every instrument chargeable with duty executed out of India may be stamped within _______________ after it is received in India.
e: Correct answer: 3 months (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which form of reinsurance limits the aggregate amount of loss the reinsured would lose on a given class of business in an annual period?
e: Correct answer: Stop loss (from the IC85 question bank).

o: Whole Account Excess of Loss cover
e: Correct answer: Whole Account Excess of Loss cover (from the IC85 question bank).

Identify the true statement with regard to Excess of loss ratio reinsurance.

I. In the event of the reinsured's net loss ratio for a given year rises above a certain percentage, this reinsurance pays in excess of that figure up to a higher agreed percentage beyond which the reinsured retains the loss.
II. This is a method that mitigates the impact of an unbearable net loss ratio.
III. This method apply on the basis of per risk (working) or catastrophe.
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

In the case of a facultative reinsurance, a policy is issued and signed by the:-

I. Reinsured
II. Reinsurer

t: Earthquake' is an example of ____________.

II. Facilitative reinsurance
